summary: Iteration 10 verified the mobile ExamTopBar + QuestionPanel footer redesign. At widths 360/390/430/520: no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth == clientWidth), exam-header-mobile is visible with all required testids (exam-title-mobile, exam-timer-mobile, exam-marking-mobile, exam-pause-btn-mobile, exam-fullscreen-btn-mobile, exam-submit-btn-mobile for non-sectional / exam-next-section-btn-mobile for sectional, plus exam-section-badge-mobile on sectional), header height is 102.5px (<130px), desktop exam-title is hidden on mobile. Footer (data-testid=question-footer) is a 4-column grid on mobile with Clear/Mark/Prev/Next icon buttons and every child button is inside the question-panel card bounds (footerRight=347/377/417/507 vs panelRight=348/378/418/508). At 1440 desktop the original testids (exam-title, exam-marking, exam-timer, exam-pause-btn, exam-fullscreen-btn, exam-submit-btn) are present and footer shows full labels 'Clear / Mark for review / Prev / Save & Next'. All mobile functional flows pass: next-btn advanced counter 1->2, prev-btn returned to 1, mark-review-btn flipped palette stat-marked to 01, clear-response-btn removed selection from option-A, exam-pause-btn-mobile opened pause-overlay and resume-test-btn closed it, exam-submit-btn-mobile opened exam-confirm-dialog. Sectional attempt (13431e10...) correctly rendered exam-next-section-btn-mobile with 'Submit section' label and exam-section-badge-mobile ('English Language').
critical_code_review_comments: ExamTopBar.jsx (96 lines) cleanly splits mobile (sm:hidden) and desktop (hidden sm:flex) layouts; shared submitBtn()/pauseBtn()/fsBtn() helpers avoid duplication.
QuestionPanel footer uses `grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 sm:flex` with icon-only buttons on mobile - all 4 buttons fit within the panel bounds at every tested width.
Mobile header height is a consistent 102.5px across 360-520 widths, well under the 130px budget.
Section badge truncation (`truncate`) prevents overflow on long section names at narrow widths.
